# Oregon Vacation Rentals — Done Right

Cascadia Getaways manages 110+ handpicked vacation homes across Oregon's best escape markets: [**Mt. Hood**,](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/mt-hood-rentals) [**the Oregon Coast**,](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/oregon-coast-rentals) and [**Wine Country**](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/wine-country-rentals). We've been doing this for over a decade, and we only operate here — because Oregon-only means we know it like the back of our hand. No distractions, just quality hospitality. Book direct and you skip the third party (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking) service fees (most guests save 15–20%), get 24/7 support from our in-house team, and reserve with confidence knowing the company on the other end of the phone is a real local business with a real local address. Whether you're chasing first chair at [Timberline](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/g/government-camp), watching whales from [Lincoln City](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/g/lincoln-city), strolling the [prom in Seaside](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/vacation-rentals/results?group=seaside), or sipping Pinot in [McMinnville](https://www.cascadiagetaways.com/g/mcminnville) — there's a Cascadia Getaways home for it.
